services.name: Morning Lake Cruise 11:00 am
services.desc: If you are registering 5 or more guests, please reach out to our Interpretive Ranger for scheduling.** In 1940, the townsite of Harrison was flooded by the TVA, covering centuries of history beneath the Chickamauga Lake. Park Interpretative Rangers will take you on a journey back through time to the Cherokee towns that preceded Harrison, as well as through Hamilton County's history which began right here! You will also learn about the park's vibrant natural resources, from its diverse shoreline habitats to the majestic bald eagles and other local wildlife that call Harrison Bay home.
